name: Entity Browser Vertical
description: Allows to display referenced entities stacked vertically in Entity Browser widgets.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 This module provides a new Entity Browser Widget Display plugin that will show labels of referenced entities, but stack them vertically using CSS.

 This is not a fully-featured tabledrag element, but it looks similar, with comparable functionality. This can be seen as a simplified / poorman's version of the patch in [#2973457] , and may become obsolete if/when that patch lands in Entity Browser.

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 After installing the module, edit your Entity Browser widget settings in the form display configuration form, and select "Entity label, stacked vertically" as the display plugin.
